'''Lin Prell''' was a [[Yevetha]] and the senior tender of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nil Spaar]]'s breederies aboard the captured [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Intimidator'']]. During his service, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Shoran]] boarded the vessel while searching for Chewbacca's partner [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]; Prell encountered the two, and fled.
